name: Perfectly Ultimate Great Moth
setName: Yu-Gi-Oh! The Sacred Cards promotional cards
ability: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by Tributing 1 "Petit Moth" on your 6th turn or later after it was equipped with "Cocoon of Evolution".

name: Riryoku
setName: Yu-Gi-Oh! The Sacred Cards promotional cards
ability: Target 2 face-up monsters on the field; halve the ATK of 1 monster, and if you do, add that lost ATK to the other monster. These effects last until the end of this turn.

name: Negate Attack
setName: Yu-Gi-Oh! The Sacred Cards promotional cards
ability: When an opponent's monster declares an attack: Target the attacking monster; negate the attack, then end the Battle Phase.

name: Exchange
setName: Yu-Gi-Oh! The Sacred Cards promotional cards
ability: Both players reveal their hands and add 1 card from each other's hand to their hand.

name: Graceful Dice
setName: Yu-Gi-Oh! The Sacred Cards promotional cards
ability: Roll a six-sided die. All monsters you currently control gain ATK/DEF equal to the result x 100, until the end of this turn.

name: Skull Dice
setName: Yu-Gi-Oh! The Sacred Cards promotional cards
ability: Roll a six-sided die. All monsters your opponent currently controls lose ATK/DEF equal to the result x 100, until the end of this turn.
